hint.en: Triggers when an alarm on the unit is no longer active. The unit is checked about once a minute.
Triggers when the unit raises an alarm, such as a polluted air filter. The unit is checked about once a minute.
Triggers when dehumidification activates.
Triggers when dehumidification deactivates.
Triggers when the unit starts de-icing the heat exchanger.
Triggers when the unit stops de-icing the heat exchanger.
Triggers when the active extract fan setpoint changes. The token value is a percentage in the range 0 to 100.
Triggers when the remaining filter life changes by at least 1 %.

title.en: Filter life dropped below a level

hint.en: Triggers once when the remaining filter life drops below the chosen level.
Triggers when free cooling activates.
Triggers when free cooling deactivates.
Triggers when the rotary heat exchanger speed changes by at least 1 %.
Triggers when the heat recovery efficiency changes by at least 1 %.
Triggers when the electric heating coil output changes by at least 1 %.
Triggers when the electric heating coil output rises above 0 %. This is actual heating, not only the coil being enabled.
Triggers when the electric heating coil output drops back to 0 %.
Triggers when the electric heating coil changes to off.
Triggers when the electric heating coil changes to on.
Triggers when the active supply fan setpoint changes. The token value is a percentage in the range 0 to 100.
Triggers when the time since the unit started drops, which means the unit restarted.
Triggers when the unit resumes ventilation after being stopped.
Triggers when the unit stops both fans.
Checks whether dehumidification is active.
Checks whether the unit is de-icing the heat exchanger right now.

title.en: Filter life is below a level

hint.en: Checks whether the remaining filter life is below the chosen level.
Checks whether free cooling is active.

title.en: Heat recovery efficiency is below a level

hint.en: Checks whether the heat recovery efficiency is below the chosen level.
Checks whether the electric heating coil output is above 0 % right now.
Checks whether the electric heating coil is currently on.
Checks whether the unit has an active alarm. The unit is checked about once a minute.
Checks whether the unit is currently stopped.

Starts a temporary high (boost) that runs for the saved high duration and then returns to the previous mode, like pressing the high button on the unit. Set the duration with the "Set high duration" action.
Resets the filter operating time on the unit after the filters are replaced.
Enables or disables de-icing of the heat exchanger on the unit.

titleFormatted.en: Set [[mode]] fan profile to supply [[supply_percent]]% and exhaust [[exhaust_percent]]%

hint.en: Updates the saved supply and exhaust fan values in percent for the selected mode on the unit.

titleFormatted.en: Set filter change interval to [[months]] months

hint.en: Updates how often the unit asks for new filters.
Updates the saved fireplace ventilation runtime in minutes on the unit.

titleFormatted.en: Set free cooling [[threshold]] difference to [[kelvin]] K

hint.en: Updates when free cooling starts or stops, as the difference between extract and outdoor air. The stop difference must stay below the start difference.

title.en: Set free cooling outdoor temperature limit

titleFormatted.en: Set free cooling outdoor temperature limit to [[temperature]] °C

hint.en: Free cooling only starts when the outdoor air is warmer than this limit. It does not stop a free cooling cycle that is already running.

title.en: Set free cooling extract air setpoint

titleFormatted.en: Set free cooling extract air setpoint to [[temperature]] °C

hint.en: Updates the extract air temperature that free cooling works towards. Free cooling can start when the extract air is warmer than this, and stops when it drops below it.

titleFormatted.en: Set [[mode]] heating coil neutral zone to [[kelvin]] K

hint.en: The electric heating coil only heats when the supply air is this far below the supply air setpoint.
Updates the saved high (boost) ventilation runtime in minutes on the unit. Use 0 to keep high mode running until it is changed.
Updates one outdoor temperature compensation value. Compensation is -10 to 10 K, winter temperatures -40 to 10 °C and summer temperatures 0 to 40 °C.

title.en: Set supply air setpoint for a mode

hint.en: Updates the saved supply air setpoint for Home or Away on the unit.
Stops both the supply and extract fan on the unit. Ventilation stays off until a fan mode is set again with the "Set fan mode" action.

title.en: Toggle heating coil on or off

titleFormatted.en: Toggle heating coil on or off

hint.en: Toggles the electric heating coil state on supported units.
Disables the unit's free cooling function. If free cooling is already running, the unit may keep it running until its minimum on-time has passed.
Enables the unit's free cooling function. The unit then starts free cooling on its own when its extract and outdoor temperature conditions are met, and runs high ventilation while it is active.
Turns off the electric heating coil on supported units.
Turns on the electric heating coil on supported units.

desc.en: Use only after replacing both filters.

hint.en: Filter replacement interval in months (Flexit GO style).
Used in Home, High, Fireplace, and Cooker operation. The supply air temperature the unit regulates towards.
Used in Away operation. The supply air temperature the unit regulates towards.
Allows the electric heating coil to heat the supply air when heat recovery alone is not enough.
The heating coil only heats when the supply air is this far below the home supply air setpoint.
The heating coil only heats when the supply air is this far below the away supply air setpoint.
How much the supply air setpoint is raised in cold weather. It ramps in from the winter start temperature and applies in full at the winter end temperature.
Outdoor temperature where winter compensation starts.
Outdoor temperature where winter compensation applies in full. Must be below the start temperature.
How much the supply air setpoint is shifted in warm weather; a negative value lowers it. It ramps in from the summer start temperature and applies in full at the summer end temperature.
Outdoor temperature where summer compensation starts.
Outdoor temperature where summer compensation applies in full. Must be above the start temperature.
Lets the unit cool the home with outdoor air when it is cooler outside: heat recovery is bypassed and ventilation runs on high. The unit decides when it runs, based on the settings below.
Based on the extract air temperature, the air leaving the rooms. Free cooling can start when the extract air is warmer than this, and stops when the extract air has cooled below it.
Free cooling only starts when the outdoor air is warmer than this. It does not stop a free cooling cycle that is already running.
Once free cooling has started, it runs at least this long before it can stop.
Free cooling only starts when the outdoor air is at least this much colder than the extract air.
Free cooling stops when the difference between extract air and outdoor air drops below this. Must be lower than the start difference.
Protects the heat exchanger against ice when it is cold outside.
Heat exchanger rotor speed while de-icing runs.
Supply fan speed while de-icing runs.
Exhaust fan speed while de-icing runs.

hint.en: The rotor is slowed down when the exhaust air is colder than this. Read-only, configured on the unit.

hint.en: The fans are adjusted when the exhaust air is colder than this. Read-only, configured on the unit.
How long each de-icing cycle runs. Read-only, configured on the unit.

Duration used when High mode is activated. Use 0 to keep it running until changed.
